VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to confirm AC1. The CI log and package.json diff verify that tests pass (72/72) and no dependencies were added (AC2 satisfied). However, there is no code diff showing the actual fix, and—critically—no evidence that the rounding drift bug is actually addressed. "All tests pass" only proves AC1 if a test specifically reproduces the rounding drift and now passes. The self-report mentions "a small guard" but provides no test demonstrating the drift was caught/fixed. Without a code diff and a regression test targeting the rounding behavior, AC1 cannot be confirmed.
